basic_info.description: Located in the heart of San Francisco's desirable Richmond District, this charming, Edwardian-style home offers unbeatable access to some of the city's best amenities. Stroll to Fulton Playground, enjoy the shops and dining along Geary and Clement, or explore nearby Land's End and the Presidio. Convenient access to Crossover Drive and Fulton Street makes getting around the city a breeze. Inside, you'll find classic wood trim, freshly painted interior and exterior, and beautifully refinished hardwood floors. The spacious primary bedroom offers potential for an additional bath ensuite, while the bright breakfast room opens to a deck overlooking the large backyard, perfect for gardening or outdoor entertaining.This home is ready for a new owner's imagination to bring it to life.
